description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicted that AI could lead to 10-20 percent unemployment in the next one to five years.

instances.assertion: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicted that AI could lead to 10-20 percent unemployment in the next one to five years.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei issued a statement on February 26, 2026, refusing to comply with the Pentagon's demands to change the company's acceptable use policy.
